## Summary

Describe the user-facing value of this change.

## Change type

- [ ] Original prompt recipe or owned asset
- [ ] Attributed external community example
- [ ] Tested example or media
- [ ] Template or prompting guidance
- [ ] Documentation or translation
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Prompt/example record

Complete when applicable:

- Recipe ID:
- Status: concept / tested
- Generation mode:
- Exact model/tool:
- Settings and date:
- Input assets and rights/consent:
- Manual edits:
- Known limitations:

## Checklist

Complete the applicable route below; do not claim ownership of linked external works.

### Original recipes and owned assets

- [ ] I created the original material and have the rights and consent needed to submit it under MIT.
- [ ] The recipe is independently authored, not copied or lightly rewritten from another source.

### Attributed external examples

- [ ] Creator, original post, prompt location, media links, check date and verification limits are recorded.
- [ ] Quotations are short, attributed and separated from my own analysis; the full prompt is linked at its source.
- [ ] Third-party works retain their owners’ rights and are not claimed as my originals or relicensed under MIT.
- [ ] No unlicensed third-party media files are committed.

### All contributions
- [ ] Model and API claims are supported by primary documentation.
- [ ] Original recipes use the correct category, ID, status and recipe structure; external examples use the separate source manifest and showcase.
- [ ] New content is linked from the relevant index.
- [ ] Relative Markdown links and headings have been checked.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, personal data, or unlicensed media are included.
- [ ] Tested examples disclose the model/tool, settings, inputs, edits, and known defects.
